notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S112 (accommodation symbols — one sheet for HOTEL, MOTEL, HOSTEL, CABINS and B & B): 420 x 350; bed symbol 70 / 280 / 70, 25 from the top; B & B 50 E white, baseline 325 (20 below the symbol box, 25 from the bottom). Layout: 420 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol bed symbol S6 at 65 % (280 wide, 230 high) x 87-329 y 48-233; B 50 E white top 275 x 112-152 (41); & 50 E white top 276 x 187-232 (45); B 50 E white top 275 x 267-307 (41).
